brief:
Israeli occupation forces demolished an agricultural shed and several plastic greenhouses belonging to Palestinian citizen Taleb Saada in the village of Kafr Sour, south of Tulkarm, on Thursday, Shehab Wire reported. The structures were destroyed roughly one week after Saada received an official notice ordering their demolition.

The operation targeted farming infrastructure used for agricultural production in the area. Local sources in the village confirmed the demolition, which left Saada without the greenhouse facilities he had used for cultivation.

title: Israeli forces demolish agricultural structures in Kafr Sour south of Tulkarm.
